content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Setup & Configuration ## slug: paylink-setup ## seoTitle: ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End :::(Warning) (**For Government Cloud Users**) Government Cloud users who want to use PayLink need to reach out to [Blackthorn Support](https://community.blackthorn.io/s/support){target="_blank"} to have instanceUrl added to their PayLink license. ::: ## Install PayLink 1. Navigate to the Payments Setup Wizard to install {{variable.Product_PayLink}}. 2. Once the install has completed, go to the {{variable.Tab_PL_PayLinkSetupWizard}}. ![L_02_setup and config](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/L_02_setup%20and%20config.png){height="" width=""} ## PayLink Setup Wizard ![PayLink Setup Wizard](https://youtu.be/6IwgaVMQTJ8){height="480" width="640"} ## Configuration Video ![Custom PayLink Configuration](https://youtu.be/WRsdtaGMlHQ){height="480" width="640"} ## Initial Configuration 1. Navigate to the Blackthorn {{variable.Product_PayLink}} app. 2. Click the PayLink Configuration tab. 3. Click {{variable.button_new}}. ![New PayLink Configuration Record](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/PayLink_NewPayLinkConfigRecord.png){height="" width=""} 5. Enter a {{variable.Field_PLConfig_Name}}. (required) 6. Set {{variable.Field_PLConfig_Default}} = “True” (checked) if this record will be the default record. 7. Move accepted payment method types from the Available column to the Chosen column. 8. Set {{variable.Field_PLConfig_CurrencySymbol}} to “Symbol” or “ISO”. (The default setting is “Symbol”.) * Example for US dollars * Symbol = “$” * ISO = “USD” 9. Add the {{variable.Field_PLConfig_AcceptLanguage}}, if using. 10. Add the {{variable.Field_PLConfig_TermsConditions}} URL, if using. 11. Use the following fields to configure the PayLink’s appearance. * {{variable.Field_PLConfig_LogoURL}} (The URL must originate outside of Salesforce.) * {{variable.Field_PLConfig_BackgroundColor}} * {{variable.Field_PLConfig_CardColorTheme}} * {{variable.Field_PLConfig_BackgroundImage}} * {{variable.Field_PLConfig_ButtonColor}} * {{variable.Field_PLConfig_DueDateLabel}} (This field overrides the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} {{variable.Field_Transaction_DueDate}} field.) * {{variable.Field_PLConfig_AmtDueLabel}} (This overrides the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} {{variable.Field_Transaction_Amount}} field.) * {{variable.Field_PLConfig_RequesteByLabel}} (This overrides the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} {{variable.Field_Transaction_Account}} field.) 14. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. ![PayLink Record.png](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/PayLink%20Record.png){height="" width=""} ### Acceptance Language and Terms & Conditions Functionality :::(Warning) (**Pre-requisite**) The {{variable.Field_PLConfig_AcceptLanguage}} field must be filled. ::: If the {{variable.Field_PLConfig_AcceptLanguage}} field has a value, the following will occur. * A checkbox will appear on the {{variable.Product_PayLink}} checkout. * The text entered in the {{variable.Field_PLConfig_AcceptLanguage}} field will be the checkbox label. ![Yes Checkbox_2](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Yes%20Checkbox_2.png){height="" width=""} If the {{variable.Field_PLConfig_AcceptLanguage}} field has a value AND the Terms and Conditions field contains a URL, then the checkbox label will be hyperlinked with the URL. *BUT* if the {{variable.Field_PLConfig_AcceptLanguage}} field is Blank, the checkbox and the accompanying hyperlinked text *WILL NOT* be visible. ![No Checkbox_1](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/No%20Checkbox_1.png){height="" width=""} * * * ![No Checkbox_2\(1\)](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/No%20Checkbox_2%281%29.png){height="" width=""} ### Image Size Considerations When adding a background image to PayLink using the {{variable.Field_PLConfig_BackgrdImageURL}} field, consider how the image will appear in {{variable.Product_PayLink}}. - We recommend using an image file no larger than 1MB. Keep in Mind: - The image you provide will cover the whole page. - All images have a certain ratio (height and width). You may need to adjust your image outside of {{variable.Product_Salesforce}} based on the viewport of the devices being used. - If your image includes text, make sure it is not cropped on different devices (desktop, tablet, mobile). You may need to edit your image outside of {{variable.Product_Salesforce}} to reorient the text. :::(Warning) (Please Read) For those using Government Cloud OR who have disallowed logins from "login.salesforce.com" in their org, please contact {{variable.Link_BlackthornSupport}} with your Salesforce org’s My Domain after installing PayLink. You can find the My Domain at Setup > My Domain. ::: Now that your {{variable.Product_PayLink}} is customized, learn [how it works](/v1/docs/how-it-works).
